text: Professional portrait, view 3/4, of a beautiful 20 age woman long-haired of platinum color, with very thick hair fluttering in the wind. The graceful and model-like atmosphere of the shot woman was captured using professional photography, studio lighting, and high-resolution images against a distant mountains with snow-capped peaks and blue sky. She is wearing Viking leather clothing trimmed with dark fur and on his back hangs a double-bladed battle axe. The image is highly detailed, with clear focus and high-quality, super realistic and cinematic lighting from above and from the side. Soft shadows, calm colors.
